If I were to use one adjective to describe myself, it would be: phenomenal.  

That’s why I ended up as the Computer Systems Administator on the Elysium, a ship of supposed elites. Elites...ha! Turns out, they’re all a bunch of idiots who nearly got us killed. I'm sure I could have prevented us from crashing...however it happened.

For me, I can bend this universe to my will. The rules of reality no longer apply. Lyn can be SO much more here.

This is Bl!tZ’s world now.

items.name: Data Circuit Model A 1/5
items.description:
“I wanna fix the sim as much as the next guy, but unpaid overtime ain’t part of a healthy work/life balance. 
 
Maybe the suits can beam me up an apprentice.” -- Frank

items.name: Data Circuit Model A 2/5
items.description: “This ordeal has given me a chance to test the simulation’s reprinting system. If I can run a wide range of scenarios, perhaps we will finally make headway in solving the larger ethical dilemmas.” -- Dr. Nishka “Lady” Bhatt

items.name: Data Circuit Model A 3/5
items.description: “You can keep your scenarios, Nishka. Anything and everything can happen here! Even something as improbable as you havin' a little fun.” -- Beatrice

items.name: Data Circuit Model A 4/5
items.description: “This simulation is just full of possibility. Maybe I could even have myself a new body... but no. No sense in dreamin'.” -- Beatrice

items.name: Data Circuit Model A 5/5
items.description: “I thought galastropods were supposed to adapt to their environment? This one looks lost. Like me. At least we have each other now.” -- Unknown

items.name: Data Circuit Model B 1/5
items.description: “Hold the horn. Simulation’s undoing all my patches, like it knows what I’m gonna do before I do it. Like maybe it’s... doin’ stuff all on its own?” -- Frank

items.name: Data Circuit Model B 2/5
items.description: “//RUNTIME ERROR// Failure Condition: Sync data corrupted. Emergency Virtual Avatar OFFLINE. Please contact Support. Code: #578929-B" -- EVA

items.name: Data Circuit Model B 3/5
items.description: "This blustery day would be perfect for tea. If only I could still drink it. Or anything for that matter." -- Beatrice

items.name: Data Circuit Model B 4/5
items.description: "I don't like to complain, but the oncoming weather is doing my joints no favors. Something big is on its way." -- Dr. Lady

items.name: Data Circuit Model B 5/5
items.description: “My snail's shell started looking all flickery and now... My only friend is just gone.” -- Unknown

items.name: Data Circuit Model C 1/5
items.description: “What the— Nearly just got my pudding fried! Everything I touch in the ATP is a live wire. Can’t open my inbox, too many crash dumps. I ain’t printed for tech support!” -Frank, Maintenance Log 34H/273-001

items.name: Data Circuit Model C 2/5
items.description: “Franky, you lugnut. I been goin’ about this all wrong. It ain’t the simulation that’s actin’ up - it’s someone inside of it. It’s one of US!” -Frank, Maintenance Log 34H/273-002

items.name: Data Circuit Model C 4/5
items.description: “Wait, whaa? That ain't nobody I ever heard of. Gotta get in there and smoke 'em out!” -Frank, Maintenance Log 34H/273-004

items.name: Data Circuit Model C 5/5
items.description: “So, I was deep in the guts of this thing, lookin’ for clues, when I—//RUNTIME ERROR// Failure Condition: Sync data corrupted.” -Frank, Maintenance Log 34H/273-005

items.name: Data Circuit Model D 1/5
items.description: "I’M BACK, BAY-BEEE! Risin’ like the dang phoenix ovah here. Some wiseguy tried to take Ol’ Franky offline, but I found out their alias—goes by ‘Bl!tZ.’ Now who could that be?” -Frank

items.name: Data Circuit Model D 2/5
items.description: “{ 1v g!vn a_Ll t#e h!ntz_Y00_N33d }” -Bl!tZ

items.name: Data Circuit Model D 3/5
items.description: “I’m concerned about the simulation’s loss of stability. Today, I tended to another poor Astroneer who was shocked during a storm. We can’t keep going like this.” -Dr. Lady

items.name: Data Circuit Model D 4/5
items.description: “What, is Bl!tZ supposed to be some kinda Astroneer hacker? Gotta be someone with a giga-chip on their shoulder but who really knows their stuff...” -Frank

items.name: Data Circuit Model D 5/5
items.description: “The world is just dissolving, and nothing I try works. I wish I had someone to ask for help. What if everything disappears...and I do too?” -Unknown
